title: Arithmetic logic unit/function generator

sources.document: TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1976, SN54181/SN74181 (bulletin DL-S 7611831, Dec 1972, rev. Oct 1976)

pins.name: A0
pins.text: operand A bit 0 (A0 with active-high data)

pins.name: B0
pins.text: operand B bit 0 (B0 with active-high data)

pins.name: M
pins.text: mode control: high = logic functions (internal carries disabled), low = arithmetic

pins.name: Cn
pins.text: ripple carry input (Cn' with active-high data)

pins.name: Cn+4
pins.text: ripple carry output (Cn+4' with active-high data)

pins.name: P
pins.text: carry propagate output for the '182 (X with active-high data)

pins.name: G
pins.text: carry generate output for the '182 (Y with active-high data)

functions.formula: F(i)' = U(i) XOR L(i) XOR K(i), see behaviour
functions.text: Each F output is one bit of the result chosen by the function table. The gate-level formulas are transcribed in behaviour from the functional block diagram (page 7-280) and checked against Table 2 for add, add with carry, subtract, XOR and AND on all 256 input pairs.

functions.formula: Cn+4 = carry out of the 4-bit arithmetic operation selected by S3..S0 with M low
functions.text: Ripple carry output. With active-high data (Table 2) a low at Cn+4' means carry. Used as a magnitude comparator in subtract mode, see the last rule in state.

functions.formula: /P = carry propagate of the 4-bit group (for the '182)
functions.text: Group propagate output; feeds a P input of the SN74182.

functions.formula: /G = carry generate of the 4-bit group (for the '182)
functions.text: Group generate output; feeds a G input of the SN74182.

functions.formula: A=B = F0 AND F1 AND F2 AND F3
functions.text: Decoded from the function outputs (an AND of the four F lines in the block diagram); goes high (off) when all F outputs are high, i.e. A = B when the ALU is in subtract mode with Cn = H.

state.changesOn: combinational (no memory); this block holds the datasheet function tables
rules: Table 1, ACTIVE-LOW DATA. Columns: S3 S2 S1 S0 | M=H logic | M=L, Cn=L (no carry) | M=L, Cn=H (with carry)
L L L L | F = A' | F = A MINUS 1 | F = A
L L L H | F = (AB)' | F = AB MINUS 1 | F = AB
L L H L | F = A' + B | F = AB' MINUS 1 | F = AB'
L L H H | F = 1 | F = MINUS 1 (2's COMP) | F = ZERO
L H L L | F = (A + B)' | F = A PLUS (A + B') | F = A PLUS (A + B') PLUS 1
L H L H | F = B' | F = AB PLUS (A + B') | F = AB PLUS (A + B') PLUS 1
L H H L | F = (A XOR B)' | F = A MINUS B MINUS 1 | F = A MINUS B
L H H H | F = A + B' | F = A + B' | F = (A + B') PLUS 1
H L L L | F = A'B | F = A PLUS (A + B) | F = A PLUS (A + B) PLUS 1
H L L H | F = A XOR B | F = A PLUS B | F = A PLUS B PLUS 1
H L H L | F = B | F = AB' PLUS (A + B) | F = AB' PLUS (A + B) PLUS 1
H L H H | F = A + B | F = (A + B) | F = (A + B) PLUS 1
H H L L | F = 0 | F = A PLUS A (*) | F = A PLUS A PLUS 1
H H L H | F = AB' | F = AB PLUS A | F = AB PLUS A PLUS 1
H H H L | F = AB | F = AB' PLUS A | F = AB' PLUS A PLUS 1
H H H H | F = A | F = A | F = A PLUS 1
Table 2, ACTIVE-HIGH DATA. Columns: S3 S2 S1 S0 | M=H logic | M=L, Cn'=H (no carry) | M=L, Cn'=L (with carry)
L L L L | F = A' | F = A | F = A PLUS 1
L L L H | F = (A + B)' | F = A + B | F = (A + B) PLUS 1
L L H L | F = A'B | F = A + B' | F = (A + B') PLUS 1
L L H H | F = 0 | F = MINUS 1 (2's COMPL) | F = ZERO
L H L L | F = (AB)' | F = A PLUS AB' | F = A PLUS AB' PLUS 1
L H L H | F = B' | F = (A + B) PLUS AB' | F = (A + B) PLUS AB' PLUS 1
L H H L | F = A XOR B | F = A MINUS B MINUS 1 | F = A MINUS B
L H H H | F = AB' | F = AB' MINUS 1 | F = AB'
H L L L | F = A' + B | F = A PLUS AB | F = A PLUS AB PLUS 1
H L L H | F = (A XOR B)' | F = A PLUS B | F = A PLUS B PLUS 1
H L H L | F = B | F = (A + B') PLUS AB | F = (A + B') PLUS AB PLUS 1
H L H H | F = AB | F = AB MINUS 1 | F = AB
H H L L | F = 1 | F = A PLUS A (*) | F = A PLUS A PLUS 1
H H L H | F = A + B' | F = (A + B) PLUS A | F = (A + B) PLUS A PLUS 1
H H H L | F = A + B | F = (A + B') PLUS A | F = (A + B') PLUS A PLUS 1
H H H H | F = A | F = A MINUS 1 | F = A
(*) Each bit is shifted to the next more significant position.

Comparator use (subtract mode S3..S0 = L,H,H,L): Cn=H, Cn+4=H -> A >= B (active-low data) / A <= B (active-high); Cn=H, Cn+4=L -> A < B / A > B; Cn=L, Cn+4=H -> A > B / A < B; Cn=L, Cn+4=L -> A <= B / A >= B

electrical.notes: SN74181: VCC 4.75-5.25 V; IOH -800 uA for all outputs except A=B; IOL 16 mA. A=B is open collector: IOH max 250 uA at VOH 5.5 V (the 5.5 V is that test condition; no separate pull-up limit is printed). Input loads: IIL mode -1.6 mA, any A or B -4.8, any S -6.4, carry -8 mA.

timing.conditions: VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm
VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm
M 0 V, S0=S3=4.5 V, S1=S2=0 V (SUM mode); CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm, 25 C
M 0 V, S0=S3=0 V, S1=S2=4.5 V (DIFF mode)

unknown: No separate maximum pull-up voltage for the open-collector A=B output beyond the 5.5 V IOH test condition.
notes: Pin 2/1/23/... names are for active-low data (Table 1); with active-high data the same pins are A0, B0, ... F0..F3, Cn', Cn+4', X (pin 15), Y (pin 17) and Table 2 applies. Subtraction is 1's complement plus forced carry.

internal.source: 7-280 (PDF page 279) - TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1976, functional block diagram (inverter on M, pin 8)

internal.formula: U0 = NOT((/A0 AND /B0 AND S3) OR (/A0 AND NOT /B0 AND S2))
internal.source: 7-280 (PDF page 279) - TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1976, functional block diagram (upper NOR of bit 0: AND gates with S3 and S2)

internal.formula: L0 = NOT((NOT /B0 AND S1) OR (/B0 AND S0) OR /A0)
internal.source: 7-280 (PDF page 279) - TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1976, functional block diagram (lower NOR of bit 0: AND gates with S1 and S0, and A alone)

internal.formula: U1 = NOT((/A1 AND /B1 AND S3) OR (/A1 AND NOT /B1 AND S2))
internal.source: 7-280 (PDF page 279) - TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1976, functional block diagram (upper NOR of bit 1: AND gates with S3 and S2)

internal.formula: L1 = NOT((NOT /B1 AND S1) OR (/B1 AND S0) OR /A1)
internal.source: 7-280 (PDF page 279) - TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1976, functional block diagram (lower NOR of bit 1: AND gates with S1 and S0, and A alone)

internal.formula: U2 = NOT((/A2 AND /B2 AND S3) OR (/A2 AND NOT /B2 AND S2))
internal.source: 7-280 (PDF page 279) - TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1976, functional block diagram (upper NOR of bit 2: AND gates with S3 and S2)

internal.formula: L2 = NOT((NOT /B2 AND S1) OR (/B2 AND S0) OR /A2)
internal.source: 7-280 (PDF page 279) - TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1976, functional block diagram (lower NOR of bit 2: AND gates with S1 and S0, and A alone)

internal.formula: U3 = NOT((/A3 AND /B3 AND S3) OR (/A3 AND NOT /B3 AND S2))
internal.source: 7-280 (PDF page 279) - TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1976, functional block diagram (upper NOR of bit 3: AND gates with S3 and S2)

internal.formula: L3 = NOT((NOT /B3 AND S1) OR (/B3 AND S0) OR /A3)
internal.source: 7-280 (PDF page 279) - TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1976, functional block diagram (lower NOR of bit 3: AND gates with S1 and S0, and A alone)
7-280 (PDF page 279) - TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1976, functional block diagram (the NAND/NOR that carries into bit 0; M low lets carries through)

internal.formula: K1 = NOT((MN AND U0 AND Cn) OR (MN AND L0))
internal.source: 7-280 (PDF page 279) - TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1976, functional block diagram (the NAND/NOR that carries into bit 1; M low lets carries through)

internal.formula: K2 = NOT((MN AND U0 AND U1 AND Cn) OR (MN AND U1 AND L0) OR (MN AND L1))
internal.source: 7-280 (PDF page 279) - TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1976, functional block diagram (the NAND/NOR that carries into bit 2; M low lets carries through)

internal.formula: K3 = NOT((MN AND U0 AND U1 AND U2 AND Cn) OR (MN AND U1 AND U2 AND L0) OR (MN AND U2 AND L1) OR (MN AND L2))
internal.source: 7-280 (PDF page 279) - TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1976, functional block diagram (the NAND/NOR that carries into bit 3; M low lets carries through)

outputs.source: 7-280 (PDF page 279) - TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1976, functional block diagram (two XOR gates of bit 0)
7-280 (PDF page 279) - TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1976, functional block diagram (two XOR gates of bit 1)

outputs.formula: /P = NOT(U0 AND U1 AND U2 AND U3)
outputs.source: 7-280 (PDF page 279) - TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1976, functional block diagram (4-input NAND to pin 15)

outputs.formula: /G = NOT(L3 OR (U3 AND L2) OR (U3 AND U2 AND L1) OR (U3 AND U2 AND U1 AND L0))
outputs.source: 7-280 (PDF page 279) - TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1976, functional block diagram (AND-NOR to pin 17)

outputs.formula: Cn+4 = NOT /G OR (U0 AND U1 AND U2 AND U3 AND Cn)
outputs.source: 7-280 (PDF page 279) - TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1976, functional block diagram (OR with inverted inputs to pin 16: G' and a 5-input NAND)
